out_of_scope.rule: files under these roots are out of scope, except registrations, which stay pinned

policy.never_loaded: checkpoints are hashed as bytes; MLX / ORT / torch are refused
policy.pinned_claim: every real-tree match of every glob in policy.pinned is either listed in files[] with that glob's category, or is a volatile match listed in volatile_checkpoints[]; check_policy() enforces this and build/verify fail when it is untrue

runstore.file_level: sha256/size of the .sqlite3 file are recorded but are NOT red criteria: when entries_digest is unchanged a sha/size change is reported as warning runstore_file_sha_changed / runstore_file_size_changed (legitimate VACUUM / WAL checkpoint)
runstore.red_criteria: entries_digest change on any database -> problem runstore_entries_changed (tables listed)
runstore.wal_shm: artifacts/**/*-wal and *-shm are transient, never pinned

policy.scan_scope: every file under artifacts/, except that under artifacts/reports/** and artifacts/spacetime/** only registration files are in scope

transient.detail: presence recorded in transient[]; never pinned

policy.unregistered_file_rule: any file present in the real tree that is not in files[], excluded_with_reason[] or transient[] and that sits inside a pinned tree (a directory that holds a pinned file, or below it) turns verify RED with unexpected_new_file. Only volatile matches are exempt.

volatile_rule.detail: recorded by path in volatile_checkpoints[]; bytes are not pinned because test runs may rewrite them

policy.writes_to_artifact_tree: none: build/verify/inventory write only below --out / --inventory paths, self-test writes only into the temporary case tree

role: read-only baseline freeze for ADR-0012 / V9 P0 (r3: C3 coverage, T3 pinned-tree scan, RunStore row-level ruling)
